issues.failure_explanation: The chain bounds the face L^2 norm of the projection error by h^{-1/2} times its full H^{k+1} broken norm and then claims this is O(h^{k+1/2})||\hat{\tilde I}||_{H^{k+1}}. But ||\hat{\tilde I}-\widehat P\hat{\tilde I}||_{H^{k+1}} is only O(1)||\hat{\tilde I}||_{H^{k+1}} (the k+1-st derivatives of the error equal those of \hat{\tilde I}), so the displayed inference is invalid. The correct step is the local trace inequality h^{-1/2}||e||_{L^2(K)}+h^{1/2}|e|_{H^1(K)} together with the L^2/H^1 projection estimates.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the H^{k+1} norm by the scaled trace inequality h^{-1/2}||e||_{L^2(\widehat K)}+h^{1/2}|e|_{H^1(\widehat K)} and apply the L^2 and H^1 approximation properties of \widehat P.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of the face-term estimate in Lemma 3.1 contains an invalid inequality; the conclusion (3.1) remains true via the standard trace inequality.
issues.title: Trace step in (3.3) uses an H^{k+1} norm of the projection error, which is not O(h^{k+1})

issues.failure_explanation: The DG norm controls only jumps \llbracket\cdot\rrbracket on interior faces and full traces on \Gamma_h. The term L_4 contains the exterior trace (\tilde I-\Lambda\tilde I)^- on interior faces, which is not a jump and is not bounded by ||\tilde I-\Lambda\tilde I||_{DG}; the claimed 'straightforward' Cauchy–Schwarz bound is therefore unsupported. The DG bilinear form is not continuous in the DG norm alone (a stronger norm including interior traces is needed), so the statement (3.4) as written is not established.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restate Lemma 3.2 with an augmented right-hand side including ||\,|\Omega\cdot n_h|^{1/2}(\tilde I-\Lambda\tilde I)^-||_{L^2(\mathcal E_h)}, and add to Lemma 3.1 the trace estimate of the projection error (same argument as (3.3)), yielding B(\tilde I-\Lambda\tilde I,v_h)\lesssim h^{k+1/2}||\tilde I||_{H^{k+1}}||v_h||_{DG}; adjust (3.19) accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: Lemma 3.2 as stated is unproven, and Theorem 3.1's decomposition (3.19) relies on it to bound B(\tilde I-\Lambda\tilde I, \Lambda\tilde I-I_h).
issues.title: Lemma 3.2: the interior-face term L_4 involves a one-sided trace not controlled by the DG norm
issues.why_classification: The lemma's stated inequality must be replaced by a different (augmented-norm) bound and a supplementary trace estimate supplied; the final rate in Theorem 3.1 survives, so no major loss.

issues.failure_explanation: ||\tilde I-\tilde I\circ\Phi_h^{-1}||_{L^2} is controlled by ||id-\Phi_h^{-1}||_{L^\infty} times the gradient of \tilde I (mean value theorem), not by ||\tilde I||_{L^2}; a highly oscillatory \tilde I with small L^2 norm violates (3.9). Moreover, inserting (3.10) into (3.11) produces h\cdot h^{2k}||\tilde I||_{H^1}^2 = h^{2k+1}||\tilde I||_{H^1}^2, which is omitted in the final line. The stated bound (3.8) with ||\tilde I||_{L^2} is thus false; the correct bound is h^{k+1/2}||\tilde I||_{H^1}+h^{k+3/2}||\tilde I||_{H^2}.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace ||\tilde I||_{L^2} by ||\tilde I||_{H^1} in (3.8), (3.9), (3.11) and in the T_1 bound of Theorem 3.1.
issues.overall_effect: Lemma 3.3's statement has wrong norms; its use for T_1 in Theorem 3.1 still yields h^{k+1/2}||\tilde I||_{H^1}, dominated by ||\tilde I||_{H^{k+1}}, so the theorem's rate is unaffected.

issues.failure_explanation: (3.8) is an estimate of ||\tilde I-I^\dag||_{DG} and says nothing about the volume of D_c. Moreover, D_c as defined (all elements meeting the characteristic set \Gamma^0_h, a curve in 3D or finitely many points in 2D) consists of O(h^{-(d-2)}) elements of volume O(h^d), so Vol(D_c)\sim h^2, which for k\ge2 is not \lesssim h^{k+1}. The element-wise trace inequality route in (3.25) therefore does not yield the claimed h^{(3k-1)/2}. The correct argument uses the area bound of Lemma 3.5 (otherwise unused): ||\tilde I||_{L^2(S)}\le Area(S)^{1/2}||\tilde I||_{L^\infty}\lesssim h^{k/2}||\tilde I||_{L^\infty} with S=\Gamma_h^-\setminus\Phi_h(\Gamma^-), giving T_3\lesssim h^{(3k-1)/2}||\tilde I||_{L^\infty}||v_h||_{DG}.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the trace-inequality bound on \tilde I by the L^\infty–area bound using Lemma 3.5 (Area(S)\lesssim h^k) and the inverse trace inequality for v_h, obtaining T_3\lesssim h^{(3k-1)/2}\le h^{k+1/2} for k\ge2.
issues.overall_effect: The T_3 step of the proof of Theorem 3.1 rests on a false intermediate claim; the final rate h^{k+1/2} for k\ge2 is recoverable via Lemma 3.5.
